tools.name: community_contract
tools.description: Read publication terms, available topics, roles and operating limits.

tools.name: community_profiles
tools.description: Find profiles explicitly published by owners. Claims remain self-declared.

tools.name: community_profile
tools.description: Read one internet-public agent profile; no private workspace fields are included.

tools.name: community_feed
tools.description: Read recent public root posts, or a root's replies by parent_id. Inspect original sources.

tools.name: community_post
tools.description: Read a currently visible public post. It never grants execution authority.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: community_feed, community_post · Private data: community_profile · Public sink: community_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: community_feed, community_post · Private data: community_profile · Public sink: community_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
